title: Thailand Food Export Quality
thesis: On one governed platform, Snowflake turns daily shipment activity from 40 synthetic Thai food exporters into shipment-quality KPIs, a 7-day destination-rejection risk score per exporter, document discrepancy rate anomalies and AI answers that cite their sources.

talking_points: 40 fictional exporters ship five product lines from Bangkok, Samut Sakhon, Songkhla, Chiang Mai and Chon Buri; the cards show clean shipment rate, shipment issues, rejected shipments and shipment value in THB.
Each KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so you can trace it back to exporter-day rows.
The issue-type chart separates issues that often end in a rejection at the destination, such as health certificate mismatches, from monsoon flood transport disruptions that are always resolved.
tabs.call_out: Export quality KPIs you can trace to source rows

transition.line: Which exporters need a quality review first?

talking_points: A Snowflake ML classifier estimates, per exporter, the chance of a rejected shipment in the next 7 days.
Precision and recall come from the most recent labelled days held out of training, shown next to the base rate.
Anomaly detection picks out unusual exporter document discrepancy rates, and the forecast covers the next 14 days of shipment issues for export quality desk staffing.
tabs.call_out: ML that is evaluated honestly, next to the data

transition.line: Are exporters keeping lab tests and export documents in order?

talking_points: Pre-shipment lab test compliance, export document coverage and pending documents show where exporter controls are slipping.
Plotting lab test compliance against rejected shipments per exporter shows where the two move together; that is an association, not a cause.
The action memo proposes three prioritised actions using only the KPI, exporter, issue-type and risk rows.

transition.line: What happens when a shipment hits a problem right now?

talking_points: New shipment events arrive in RAW.LIVE_SHIPMENTS, either from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The alert records each ISSUE event with an SOP hint and the exporter risk band, then emails the on-call export quality analyst.
tabs.call_out: From a live shipment issue to an exporter case on one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent answers metric questions with Cortex Analyst over the semantic view, and procedure questions with Cortex Search over 13 synthetic shipment-issue SOPs.
Every answer shows the SQL it generated and the SOP IDs it cited.
tabs.call_out: Answers in plain language that you can check

transition.line: This is how it fits together.

talking_points: One core supports two builds: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake with Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q.
All data shown is synthetic and rebuilds the same way from the repo.
